children: Calci announced it has regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement after meeting the 10 consecutive business day threshold.
Nasdaq notified Calci on Sept. 15, 2026 that the closing bid met or exceeded $1.00 for 10 business days (Aug 31–Sept 14).
Calci had been under a compliance notice from March 16, 2026 with a deadline of Sept. 14, 2026 to regain compliance.
As of this filing, Calci has no outstanding deficiency notices from Nasdaq.
